verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a pricing-page line saying ClickHouse Cloud lets you "export backups to your own cloud account". That implies a managed backup feature exists, but nothing describes how it works. missing for 10: evidence that backups run automatically on a schedule, a visible and configurable backup schedule or retention, self-serve restore workflows, in-depth backup/restore docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
